## Q1-010 — Does effective information above its own shuffle null separate coordination, or does it separate determinism?

The suspicion that the headline statistic reads determinism rather than coordination was tested on the slot family and FAILED its own frozen gate: coordinated +6.3 null sd, deterministic-but-independent +1.65, independent draw ~0. That suspicion is not resolved on the commons, where an uncoordinated arm sits 5.3 null sd up and no experiment explains it; the clause holds on the slot family only.

*result_reviewed* · [q1_010_determinism_control](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_010_determinism_control.md) · [q1_010_determinism_control_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_010_determinism_control_results.md)

## Q1-009 — Does a coarse-grained description of these specimens carry causal structure the micro description does not, and does an independent goal-free measure agree?

No causal emergence on either specimen: the coarse-grained description carries strictly LESS effective information than the micro one it was built from, in every non-degenerate arm. A later review found eight defects in this experiment's own code; every effective-information value survived, every empowerment value moved.

*result_reviewed* · [q1_009_information_measures](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_009_information_measures.md) · [q1_009_information_measures_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_009_information_measures_results.md)

## Q1-008 — Is the clause-2 floor caused by the substrate's congestion coupling?

The statistic's floor is its own finite-sample null, about 0.12 at this horizon and entity count — not any property of the substrate. This experiment then committed the same below-null gate error it was written to catch.

*result_reviewed* · [q1_008_null_coupling_control](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_008_null_coupling_control.md) · [q1_008_null_coupling_control_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_008_null_coupling_control_results.md)

## Q1-007 — Does removing the substrate's congestion coupling let the relation statistic meet clause 2?

The congestion explanation this experiment was built on is refuted: removing the coupling entirely RAISES the statistic instead of lowering it. Lane stopped.

*result_reviewed* · [q1_007_congestion_corrected_relation](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_007_congestion_corrected_relation.md) · [q1_007_congestion_corrected_relation_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_007_congestion_corrected_relation_results.md)

## Q1-006 — Can a statistic measure whether entity differences are related, rather than merely present?

Coordinated scored 0.284 against matched-random 0.108. The clause-2 gate was frozen at 0.10 — BELOW the statistic's own finite-sample null — so no independent process could ever have passed it, and the recorded failure measured an unachievable gate.

*result_reviewed* · [q1_006_pairwise_relation](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_006_pairwise_relation.md) · [q1_006_pairwise_relation_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_006_pairwise_relation_results.md)

## Q1-005 — Does the idiosyncratic fraction measure coordination, or only differentiation?

The advantage over matched randomness is about 17% relative, not the total effect an earlier comparison implied: matched random reaches 0.375 against derived phase's 0.438. Most of the benefit is desynchronization, which randomness supplies free.

*result_reviewed* · [q1_005_idiosyncratic_fraction](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_005_idiosyncratic_fraction.md) · [q1_005_idiosyncratic_fraction_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_005_idiosyncratic_fraction_results.md)

## Q1-004 — Does the frozen detector, unchanged, separate a differentiated population from an active undifferentiated one on a family it was not built for?

The instrument recovered an authored coordination on a second family it was not built for — a directional pass, carrying a caveat about the statistic it leans on.

*result_reviewed* · [q1_004_second_family_qualification](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_004_second_family_qualification.md) · [q1_004_second_family_qualification_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_004_second_family_qualification_results.md)

## C2-002 — How load-bearing is the derivation rule that turns a subunit's own goal into a phase?

The derivation rule matters only through how many distinct phases it preserves, which is one line of algebra about gcd(a, P) rather than an empirical discovery.

*result_reviewed* · [c2_002_rule_load_bearing](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/c2_002_rule_load_bearing.md) · [c2_002_rule_load_bearing_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/c2_002_rule_load_bearing_results.md)

## C2-001 — Can the distinguishing information that breaks symmetry come from the environment's own heterogeneity rather than from a designer assigning labels?

Environmental heterogeneity can substitute for designer-assigned identity: satisfaction rises 0.000 to 0.438 as need spread widens, tracking distinct phases 1.0 to 6.6. Both the derivation rule and the period, which equals the population size, are still authored.

*result_reviewed* · [c2_001_derived_phase](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/c2_001_derived_phase.md) · [c2_001_derived_phase_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/c2_001_derived_phase_results.md)

## C1-002 — Does a shared-scalar coordination signal transfer from a divisible renewable resource to an indivisible contended slot?

The same mechanism could not coordinate an indivisible slot at all. A shared scalar every subunit reads identically is common-mode by construction: it can gate a population together but never stagger it, so C1 is a price mechanism and needs a divisible good.

*result_reviewed* · [c1_002_contended_channel](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/c1_002_contended_channel.md) · [c1_002_contended_channel_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/c1_002_contended_channel_results.md)

## Q1-003 — Can a candidate family with a latent shared regressor separate a shared quantity that gates decisions from one that only constrains outcomes?

A candidate family carrying a latent shared regressor closes the gap — but the record says plainly it does not qualify the instrument, because its author wrote it knowing the answer.

*result_reviewed* · [q1_003_latent_shared_regressor](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_003_latent_shared_regressor.md) · [q1_003_latent_shared_regressor_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_003_latent_shared_regressor_results.md)

The gap is not how the cases are packaged; it is what the model family can say. Repackaging changes nothing.

## Q1-001 — Can the analytic instrument recover an authored coordination it was not told about, and not report it where it is absent?

Handed a matched pair differing only in whether a coordinating signal was present, the instrument returned the SAME disposition for both. The candidate family has no way to express dependence on a shared quantity, so coordination is unrepresentable rather than merely undetected.

*result_reviewed* · [q1_001_instrument_qualification](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_001_instrument_qualification.md) · [q1_001_instrument_qualification_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/q1_001_instrument_qualification_results.md)

## C1-001 — Does a shared scarcity signal have to track scarcity, or does the best fixed threshold coordinate as well?

A shared scarcity signal beat the best fixed threshold on a renewable commons, 1.000 against 0.500 over 8 seeds — but the pre-registered control was weaker than claimed, and the effect size was revised down in the record.

*result_reviewed* · [c1_001_shared_scarcity_signal](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/c1_001_shared_scarcity_signal.md) · [c1_001_shared_scarcity_signal_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/c1_001_shared_scarcity_signal_results.md)

## P15 — Can a modest type-directed proposal layer produce decision-relevant relational candidates or honest abstention across opaque archived systems without task labels?

The freeze/reveal/audit machinery works end to end, but the capability it was meant to reward does not exist: applying all four proposers to all four cases gives an empty off-diagonal, so proposal generality measured zero.

*result_reviewed* · [p15_proposal_layer_benchmark](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/p15_proposal_layer_benchmark.md) · [p15_proposal_layer_benchmark_results](../goal-discovery/docs/hypotheses/p15_proposal_layer_benchmark_results.md)
